title: Rumored crash in Chinese territory

tellings.quote: And I've heard a lot of rumors when I did business in China, which I did for years. >> Yeah. >> With the Chinese government that there was something that crashed >> in Chinese territory. I think the Russians got it though.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer who spent years doing business with the Chinese government, says that while he was there he heard many rumors that something unexplained had crashed on Chinese soil. He adds that he thinks the Russians ended up getting it. If true, it would mean other countries besides the United States have recovered strange crashed craft.
